title: First Skywatcher observation: class 1 'tetra' formation during a 2021 war game

tellings.quote: games. On one of these war games in 2021 year we did observation. It turned out to be NAYA first class, and

plain: During a US military war game in 2021, a team observed what it classed as a first-class 'tetra' formation in the sky, according to James Valor, who is part of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs into view. Valor tells Michels he was there for that first observation and credits a person he names only as Mr. K. If true, it would mean these objects showed up, and were recorded, in the middle of a military exercise.
